questions.funds_at_risk: Does the evidence explicitly describe direct loss, theft or permanent lock of user funds?
questions.file_write_or_exec: Does the evidence explicitly describe writing files or executing code outside the intended boundary (e.g. path traversal, symlink escape, RCE)?
questions.no_privileges: Does the evidence explicitly say an unprivileged external attacker can trigger it?
questions.state_corruption: Does the evidence explicitly describe corruption of protocol state or accounting without direct fund loss?
questions.dos_only: Does the evidence explicitly say the impact is limited to denial of service or griefing?
